text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that past defeat, I've devoted 
myself wholeheartedly to devising 
countermeasures for this very day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trusting in your guidance, I have applied 
myself diligently. It is fair to say I 
have done everything conceivably possible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Then there is no need for further words. 
All that remains is to show it through 
results!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, from this point forward, on my 
imperial path, I shall never permit 
defeat!
